housing.summary: Lucerne is a popular tourist and expat destination in central Switzerland. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 1,748/month per Numbeo (Aug 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need valid ID, proof of Swiss residence registration (Anmeldebestätigung), and permit (non-EU). Main banks in Lucerne: UBS, Luzerner Kantonalbank (LUKB), and Raiffeisen. PostFinance serves the whole country.
required_docs: Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)

schools.summary: Lucerne has a small but established international school sector. International School of Zug and Lucerne (ISZL) serves both cantons with IB curriculum. The canton's main schools operate in German. Given the tourism industry, bilingual options are increasing.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the Einwohnerkontrolle of their Lucerne municipality within 14 days of arrival. EU/EFTA nationals register for permit B or L at the Dienststelle Migration des Kantons Luzern. Non-EU nationals need a cantonal permit. Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: The AHV-Nummer (OASI number) serves as the Swiss tax and social insurance ID, assigned by the SVA Luzern (cantonal compensation office) or employer. Lucerne canton applies cantonal income and wealth taxes; rates are moderate compared to Zurich or Bern. Withholding tax applies for foreign residents without a C-permit.

transport.summary: Lucerne's public transport is operated by VBL (Verkehrsbetriebe Luzern), including buses and the Luzern S-Bahn (integrated into the ZVV-like luzern-verkehr.ch network). A monthly pass costs approximately CHF 80 per Numbeo data. EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Strassenverkehrsamt Kanton Luzern without a driving test. Mandatory Krankenversicherung must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/OFSP.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at Strassenverkehrsamt Luzern (strassenverkehrsamt.lu.ch); non-EU licences generally require theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (Krankenversicherung/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
